titleEn: The Night of the Closing Ceremony
summary: After three years, the cadets are ranked. The top ten may choose the interior. Eren chooses the wings, and the night ends with the choice still warm.

segments.ja: 訓練の三年が、評価の日に着きます。着いたクラスは、もう初日の逆さの少年たちではありません。ではありません。立体機動を使い、刃の型を覚え、巨人の模型を切るところまで来ています。来た先で、キースは最後の点数を読みます。読む点数は、個人の順位です。順位の上位十人だけが、内側の憲兵を志願できます。できる席は、安全の席です。安全を、全員が同じ意味では見ていません。
segments.en: The three years of training arrive at the day of evaluation. The class that arrived is no longer the upside-down boys of the first day. It is not. They have come as far as using the ODM gear, learning blade forms, and cutting Titan dummies. At the place they have come to, Keith reads the last scores. The scores he reads are individual ranks. Only the top ten of the ranks may apply to the interior police. The seats that may are seats of safety. Not everyone sees safety with the same meaning.

segments.ja: 評価の前に、組手の記憶が残っています。残っている場面で、アニはエレンを地面に落とします。落とす技は、力の大きさではありません。大きさではなく、相手の勢いを使う角度です。角度を、彼女は短く実演します。実演のあと、エレンは自分の怒りが技になっていなかったことを知ります。知る恥は、ベルトの夜に似ています。似ている発見は、また手順です。手順を、アニは友人の助言としては渡しません。渡さない冷たさの下に、正確さがあります。
segments.en: Before the evaluation, a memory of sparring remains. In the scene that remains, Annie drops Eren to the ground. The technique that drops him is not the size of strength. It is not size. It is an angle that uses the opponent's momentum. She demonstrates the angle shortly. After the demonstration, Eren learns that his anger had not become technique. The shame he learns resembles the night of the belt. The discovery that resembles it is again a procedure. Annie does not hand the procedure over as a friend's advice. Under the coldness of not handing it over, there is exactness.

segments.ja: ミカサは、順位のいちばん上です。上であることに、クラスは驚きません。驚かない次に、ライナー、ベルトルト、アニが続きます。続く五位が、エレンです。エレンの五位は、才能の一位ではありません。一位ではなく、やめなかった結果です。結果の下に、ジャンがいます。いるジャンは、十位の内側に入ります。入った席が、彼の安全なポストへの切符です。切符を、コニーやサシャの位置が囲みます。
segments.en: Mikasa is at the very top of the ranks. The class is not surprised that she is at the top. Without surprise, Reiner, Bertholdt, and Annie follow. The fifth who follows is Eren. Eren's fifth is not first place of talent. It is not first. It is the result of not having quit. Under the result is Jean. The Jean who is there gets inside the tenth place. The seat he got inside is his ticket to a safe post. The positions of Connie and Sasha surround the ticket.

segments.ja: ジャンは、十位の意味を隠しません。隠さない意味は、内側で眠り、外の翼では死なない、です。死なない選択を、彼は臆病とは呼びません。呼ばない理由は、母が自分の生存を望んでいる、です。望んでいる生存を、エレンは再び外への逃避だと言います。と言う対立は、三年で慣れています。慣れていても、今夜は順位がそれを公式にします。公式の席で、ジャンはミカサの強さを認めつつ、自分の道を変えません。
segments.en: Jean does not hide the meaning of tenth place. The meaning he does not hide is to sleep inside, and not to die on the outside wings. He does not call the choice of not dying cowardice. The reason he does not call it that is that his mother wants his survival. Eren again calls the survival she wants an escape to the outside's opposite. The opposition of that calling is familiar after three years. Even familiar, tonight the ranks make it official. In the official seat, Jean admits Mikasa's strength and does not change his own road. He does not change it.

segments.ja: アルミンは、海の話を今夜も捨てません。捨てない本は、もう紙としては古びています。古びた想像を、エレンが自分の入隊の理由の半分にします。半分のもう一つは、母です。母と海が、同じ外の方向を指します。指す方向を、ジャンは信じません。信じない彼は、見たことのない水のために死ぬ理由がない、と言います。と言う現実を、アルミンは否定しません。否定しないまま、それでも見たい、と残します。
segments.en: Again tonight, Armin does not throw away the talk of the sea. The book he does not throw away is already old as paper. Eren makes the old imagination half the reason for his enlistment. The other half is his mother. Mother and sea point in the same outside direction. Jean does not believe the direction they point. He, not believing, says there is no reason to die for water he has never seen. Armin does not deny the reality he states. Without denying it, he still leaves the words I want to see it.

segments.en: Partway through the night, Hannes visits the training ground. He, visiting, is no longer only the daytime-drink soldier of Shiganshina. He is not only that. He is in a position leading a Garrison squad. Still in the position, he looks at Eren's growth. He lays over the growth he looks at the question of whether his feet failed to stop on that day. The guilt he lays over it has not disappeared yet. The adult it has not disappeared from does not simply celebrate Eren going to the Survey. The reason he does not celebrate is that he knows the outside does not return a mother. Knowing that, he taps the boy's shoulder once.

segments.en: Reiner asks Eren why he will go that far outside. The voice that asks is a classmate's interest. Nobody tonight measures that another mission is hidden in the depth of the interest. segments.en: With the right of first place, Mikasa can go anywhere. Ahead of where she can go is safety inside. She does not consider the safety that is there. The reason she does not consider it is that Eren is going to the Survey. Even if the destination is dangerous, the rank does not bind her choice. The unbound first place makes it easy to stay beside him. The class sees the choice she made easy as a matter of course. The matter of course they see does not hide her fear. The fear she does not hide is strength. She places the use of the strength not on her own survival but on Eren's.

segments.en: After finishing the ranks, Keith does not give a long encouragement. The instructor who does not places only one sentence of the reality outside the walls. Without knowing, they stand up from their seats. Keith looks at the backs that stand with a different eye only for the Jaeger heat. The eye that looks still does not tell the student his father's name. The silence of not telling is the instructor's personal page.
